title: Vibrant Ultra Quiet Resonator
description:
Eliminate harsh exhaust drone and tone down rasp without sacrificing flow. The Vibrant Performance Ultra Quiet Resonator is designed to significantly reduce exhaust noise on high-performance street and track setups while maintaining a straight-through internal design for maximum power.

Featuring a larger sound-absorption chamber than standard round resonators, the Ultra Quiet design utilizes a multi-layer sound suppression material packed inside a heavy-duty, 100% T304 stainless steel body. Ideal for turbo, supercharged, and high-compression naturally aspirated builds running aggressive headers or catless setups.

#### Key Features:

* Maximum Noise Reduction: Engineered with a larger sound expansion chamber to kill high-frequency drone and unwanted rasp.
* Straight-Through Performance: Zero restriction internal tube design ensures no loss in exhaust flow or horsepower.
* Full T304 Stainless Steel: All-stainless construction resists rust and high exhaust temperatures under demanding track conditions.
* Universal Weld-On Fitment: Clean, symmetrical body style easily fits into tight mid-pipe and tunnel locations.

#### Sizing & Options:

* 2.25" Inlet/Outlet — (P/N 1140)
* 2.50" Inlet/Outlet — (P/N 1141)
* 3.00" Inlet/Outlet — (P/N 1142)

#### Specs:

* Material: 100% T304 Stainless Steel
* Body Style: Oval Ultra Quiet Design
* Installation: Weld-on universal replacement
